gloss: gossip; speaking ill of someone behind their back

definitions.gloss: gossip; talking negatively about someone behind their back
definitions.explanation: Speaking ill of someone when they are not present; malicious gossip.

examples.japanese: {陰口|かげぐち}を{言|い}うのはよくない。
examples.english: It's not good to talk behind people's backs.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{陰口|かげぐち}を{叩|たた}かれている。
examples.english: People are gossiping about her behind her back.

examples.japanese: {陰口|かげぐち}ばかり{言|い}う{人|ひと}は{信用|しんよう}できない。
examples.english: You can't trust people who are always gossiping about others.

notes:
WORD FORMATION:
{陰|かげ} (shadow, behind) + {口|くち} (mouth, speech) → speech made in the shadows

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
・{陰口|かげぐち}を{言|い}う / {叩|たた}く (to gossip, to badmouth)
・{陰口|かげぐち}を{言|い}われる / {叩|たた}かれる (to be gossiped about)
・{陰口|かげぐち}が{多|おお}い (there's a lot of gossip)

CONTRAST:
・{陰口|かげぐち} (behind one's back) ↔ {面|めん}と{向|む}かって (to one's face)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{悪口|わるぐち} (badmouthing) - negative talk, can be direct or behind the back
・{噂|うわさ} (rumor) - talk about someone, not necessarily negative
・{陰口|かげぐち} - specifically negative talk behind someone's back

CULTURAL NOTE:
{陰口|かげぐち} is generally considered very negative behavior in Japanese social contexts, as it damages group harmony ({和|わ}).
